# wordcell

> A local Markdown knowledge base with superpowers. Save decisions, sources,
> and plans as files you own; recover them through exact and semantic search,
> typed relationships, backlinks, and Git history. Exact search and graph
> queries run locally without an account or model. Web capture, optional remote
> reranking, and hosted agents have separate data-handling boundaries.

When to use this site:
- Use wordcell.io to learn what Wordcell is, the boundaries it keeps, and the
  current verified install command.
- Use /developers for the coding-agent workflow: repository-path context,
  AGENTS.md rules, Git history, and the Agent Skill.
- Use /docs for the Diataxis-organized documentation: a tutorial, how-to
  guides, the command reference, and design explanations.

## Pages

- [Wordcell](https://wordcell.io/): Quick start, the typed-ontology and
  retrieval model, measured context and SciFact retrieval evidence, comparisons,
  selected-note publishing, local-data boundaries, and the verified install.
- [For developers](https://wordcell.io/developers): The coding-agent workflow:
  code-path context, scoped rules, note history, and the Agent Skill.
- [Documentation](https://wordcell.io/docs): The documentation index grouped by
  Diataxis quadrant, with an install panel.
- [Get started](https://wordcell.io/docs/getting-started): The first-vault
  tutorial.
- [Overview](https://wordcell.io/docs/overview): The complete product README
  rendered as one page.
- [Agent workflow](https://wordcell.io/docs/agent-workflow): Set up, query,
  maintain, and revise repository memory.
- [Reference](https://wordcell.io/docs/reference): Exact commands, formats,
  SDK imports, and optional adapters.
- [Publish](https://wordcell.io/docs/publish): Select notes and build a static
  site.
- [Comparisons](https://wordcell.io/docs/comparisons): Markdown, QMD, Basic
  Memory, Obsidian, and Wordcell from primary sources.
- [Evidence](https://wordcell.io/docs/evidence): The reproducible
  context-payload study.
